name: Inflation, consumer prices (annual %) — India
description: Annual percentage change in the cost to the average consumer of a basket of goods and services.
aggregation: Annual average price level; percentage change over the previous year
variable_relation: An annual counterpart of this variable, not the same measure: the World Bank series is the change in the annual average consumer price index, while the variable is defined as monthly year-on-year CPI inflation (MoSPI). Use it for long-run context, not as a monthly reading.

dataset.name: World Development Indicators
dataset.attribution: The World Bank: World Development Indicators. The original source of each series is named on the series.
